Provenance

This report is qmd/reports/arms/arm-baseline.qmd, rendered once per arm by R/render_arm_reports.R. It reads only cached baselines under output/scenarios/arms/<arm>/runs/baseline.RDS and runs no model.

The nine blocks and the rule that a block containing gdef is drawn at levels rather than indexed are taken from ../LEEDS/policyreport 2/policy-report-aug13.Rmd. The two differences from that original: the two series are two arms rather than a baseline and a shock, so there is no shock line and no normalisation to a pre-shock period; and the index base is t = 2 rather than t = 1, because pa is 0 at t = 1.
